caption_L1: Here a bar plot is called Estimated change in GDP in selected countries due to economic crisis in percent. The x-axis measures 2009 * along categorical scale from −8 to 0 while the y-axis measures Country as categorical scale starting at Austria and ending at USA.
caption_L2L3: Almost all countries showed some degree of GDP drop with the only exception being Cyprus showing slightly improved GDP.  The average GDP drop in 2009 was between -2 and -6 with only Ireland and Japan having a drop greater than -6.  Only 2 countries, Malta and Greece showed a drop of less than -2 but greater than 0.
